A SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PROCESS

From business problem to working solution.

You don't need a technical brief. We start with what is not working, what takes too much time, or what you would like to improve.

01UNDERSTAND

Tell me about your business.

We discuss what you do, what is currently difficult and what you would like to improve.

02REVIEW

I look at what you already have.

Your website, spreadsheets, reports or current process may already contain much of what we need.

03BUILD

I create a working first version.

Instead of presenting only an idea, I build something you can actually see, test and use.

04REFINE

We review it together.

You see the result, give practical feedback and we make focused improvements without changing what already works.

05LAUNCH

Test. Finalise. Go live.

We check desktop, mobile and the important links and functions before the solution goes live.

You stay involved without needing to manage the technical work.

Clear communication, visible progress and practical decisions at each stage.
